_comment: RSNA 2023 Abdominal Trauma Detection Challenge. Multi-institution abdominal CT release, 3,147 patients with 4,711 series total (~1.5 per patient, often one non-contrast and one portal-venous-phase). Per-slice DICOMs under train_images/<patient_id>/<series_id>/<instance_number>.dcm. Integrated as 3D per-series classification: image_path points at the series directory and MONAI's ITKReader assembles the 3D volume. Patient-level labels (14 columns covering 5 organs) are joined onto each of that patient's series in the harmonizer.

primary_csv._comment: train_2024.csv — one row per patient_id with the 14 patient-level binary label columns. Sits one level above base_image_dir (auto-discovered).

secondary_csv._comment: train_series_meta.csv — one row per series_id with patient_id, aortic_hu, incomplete_organ. Required for the per-series enumeration in the harmonized output. Auto-discovered.

patient_id._comment: patient_id column from train_2024.csv (cast to string).

study_id._comment: No separate study UID in this release. Patient is the study unit; we copy patient_id into study_id so patient-level splits stay correct.

series_id._comment: series_id column from train_series_meta.csv (cast to string).

image_path._comment: DICOM series DIRECTORY (not a single file). MONAI's ITKReader loads all .dcm files in the directory. Relative to base_image_dir (which points at train_images/).

labels._comment: 14 binary patient-level labels covering 5 organs. bowel and extravasation are binary (healthy vs injury); kidney/liver/spleen are 3-class one-hot (healthy / low-grade / high-grade); plus an any_injury summary flag. Replicated across each of the patient's series during harmonization.

separate_csv._comment: Labels are in the primary CSV.

uncertain_handling._comment: Labels are final consensus 0/1 — no NaN or -1 values in the release.

view_position._comment: Not applicable — all studies are axial abdominal CT.

masks._comment: Organ segmentation masks ship in the dataset's segmentations/ directory for a subset of series, but are not wired into this initial harmonizer. Add to a future MASK_SOURCE_COL if needed.

bboxes._comment: image_level_labels_2024.csv ships 15,632 (patient_id, series_id, instance_number, injury_name=Active_Extravasation) point annotations. Could be wired as 3-D bbox dots like the lumbar-spine integration (commit d1d0535) in a follow-up.

extra_init_params._comment: hu_window tuple (default (-150, 250)) is accepted by the dataset constructor; covers soft-tissue / contrast-enhanced abdomen which is the relevant range here (different from CTPA's -1000 to 1000 lung window).

custom_preprocessing: Custom harmonize() reads both train_2024.csv (per-patient labels) and train_series_meta.csv (per-series), inner-joins on patient_id to emit one row per series with patient labels replicated. Aortic_hu and incomplete_organ ride through as EXTRA_OUTPUT_COLS. image_path is a DICOM series directory, so the harmonizer and dataset both override verify_images to use os.path.isdir.
